correctness.rationale: The gain-sum identity excludes imbalanced blocks in any Nash partition; exact direct deviations prove the three complementary real-parameter stability conditions. A labeled multiset argument derives the count, and a global welfare quadratic plus convex capped block allocation proves both welfare extrema and the zero-welfare resonances. Direct exact-rational verification tested 533,660 complete partition/parameter instances and 6,215 equilibrium incidences; only the algebraic proof establishes all sizes and positive real q.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a natural all-population-size classification, a closed labeled equilibrium count and a sharp quantitative welfare phase diagram for symmetric signed two-type coalition formation. It proves a genuine balance principle and pinpoints exact rational zero-welfare resonances, resolving a structural gap beyond existence or a finite-case census.
